query_text: Create a ranked horizontal bar chart showing the top 10 countries by local-versus-global divergence, where the plotted value is `average absolute difference between national_rank_change and global_rank_change across cities with numeric values in both fields within each 3.2 national block`, values are expressed in rank positions, only countries with at least 4 cities having both numeric change values are eligible, and bars are sorted from highest to lowest after the divergence is computed.
selection_rule: top 10 among countries with at least 4 cities having both numeric change fields

plot_spec.title: Local-versus-Global Divergence
plot_spec.xlabel: average absolute gap in rank positions
